modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Thompson (ankle) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Cavaliers.
injury.detail: Thompson sat out Thursday's practice and could miss Friday's game due to left ankle soreness. If the veteran sharpshooter is held out of the front end of this back-to-back set, Andrew Wiggins, Tim Hardaway and Ryan Conwell could see increased burn, especially if Pelle Larsson (illness) is also ruled out.

injury.shortComment: Da Silva (calf) is questionable for Friday's game against Milwaukee.
injury.detail: Da Silva is in danger of missing a third straight game with a left calf strain. Alex Morales, Goga Bitadze and Jase Richardson would continue to see more opportunities if da Silva is unable to go Friday night.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: Murphy is now in line to miss a third consecutive contest with a knee issue. Herbert Jones should continue to start for the Pelicans on Friday, but Saddiq Bey is likely to notice a larger bump in fantasy value.

injury.shortComment: Powell (shoulder) is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks.
injury.detail: Powell is trying to avoid a third consecutive absence due to a shoulder injury. With rookie standout Caleb Wilson (hand) going on the shelf for multiple weeks, Tre Jones and Isaac Okoro both have a chance to step up for the Bulls.

injury.shortComment: Nesmith (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Knicks.
injury.detail: Nesmith picked up a knee injury during Wednesday's game against Washington, and he was ultimately unable to return after being diagnosed with knee soreness. He'll likely test his knee during shootaround and pregame to determine if he can take the court Friday.

injury.shortComment: Larsson (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Larsson didn't participate in Thursday's practice and is in danger of missing Friday's contest. If the 25-year-old swingman is unable to play, Andrew Wiggins and Tim Hardaway would be candidates for expanded roles.

injury.shortComment: Cain (shoulder) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
injury.detail: Cain was unable to go Wednesday against the Jazz due to a shoulder injury, but it appears as though he'll have a chance to return in time for Friday's clash. The team should have another update on his availability closer to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Vassell is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left adductor tightness.
injury.detail: Vassell is trying to avoid a third consecutive absence with the issue. Julian Champagnie would likely draw a third straight start at power forward for the Spurs on Friday if Vassell is unable to play.

injury.shortComment: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Clippers.
injury.detail: Mitchell is in danger of missing a second straight game while nursing a left ankle sprain. He'll likely need to test the ankle out during shootaround and warmups to determine whether he can go Friday night.

injury.shortComment: Fox is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left hip soreness.
injury.detail: Fox is in danger of missing his first game of the 2026-27 season after picking up a hip injury. He'll presumably be re-evaluated again at some point before tipoff to determine his availability for Friday. Jordan McLaughlin and Julian Champagnie could see more minutes if Fox is unable to suit up.

injury.shortComment: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injury.detail: Smart, who was ejected from Wednesday's game for punching Charles Bassey, will begin serving his suspension Friday night against the Jazz, meaning he'll be eligible to return Wednesday versus Indiana. Bruce Thornton and Reed Sheppard should be in line for more minutes while Smart serves his three-game ban.

injury.shortComment: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is probable for Friday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: The superstar forward appears on track to suit up Friday despite dealing with a wrist sprain. Barring any setbacks, Antetokounmpo should be able to handle a normal workload and will be aiming to extend his streak of double-doubles with at least 20 points and 10 rebounds to nine games.

injury.shortComment: Flemings (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Flemings is in danger of missing his second contest of the year due to a lumbar spasm. The rookie first-rounder recently leapfrogged CJ McCollum for a starting spot, but the latter would likely rejoin the first unit if the former sits out Friday.

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa (ankle) is questionable to play Friday's game against the Trail Blazers.
injury.detail: Achiuwa is dealing with left ankle soreness after exiting Tuesday's 107-100 loss to Orlando during the third quarter. He was unable to return to the contest, and his questionable designation suggests there's a decent chance he'll be forced to sit out against Portland. If Achiuwa is sidelined, Dylan Cardwell and Keegan Murray should earn the vacated minutes, with Murray the likeliest to join the starting unit.

injury.shortComment: McGowens (elbow) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.
injury.detail: McGowens is expected to miss the first leg of this back-to-back set due to a left elbow infection. With Trey Murphy (knees) and Bennedict Mathurin (thumb) also doubtful to play, Jordan Poole, AJ Johnson and Herbert Jones are in line for increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Mathurin (thumb) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against Memphis.
injury.detail: Mathurin is expected to miss a second consecutive contest with a right thumb sprain. The Pelicans are also listing Trey Murphy (knees), Yves Missi (knee) and Bryce McGowens (elbow) as doubtful, so the team could be shorthanded in the front end of this back-to-back set. If Mathurin is ruled out, Jordan Poole and Herbert Jones would be candidates for increased minutes.

injury.shortComment: Bassey is probable for Friday's game against the Spurs due to left toe soreness.
injury.detail: It's not clear as to when this injury popped up for Bassey, who missed the first two games of the season with a knee issue but has been otherwise healthy. Expect the team to confirm his availability for Friday as tipoff nears.

injury.shortComment: Swain (back) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Atlanta.
injury.detail: Swain is in danger of missing a second straight game due to right disc irritation. However, his potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

injury.shortComment: McConnell is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to a right hamstring strain.
injury.detail: McConnell continues to land on the injury report with a hamstring issue, but it's a positive sign that he's been listed as probable after being handed a questionable tag ahead of Indiana's previous three games. He's in line to play in a fourth consecutive game after logging a season high in minutes (14) Wednesday night against Washington.
